metadata.title: Δmension Formula Library
metadata.description: Multi-language implementations of mathematical formulas for 3D visualization

formulas.name: Sphere Parametric Equations
formulas.latex: x = r\sin(\phi)\cos(\theta), \quad y = r\sin(\phi)\sin(\theta), \quad z = r\cos(\phi)
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a sphere of radius r using spherical coordinates

formulas.name: Torus Parametric Equations
formulas.latex: x = (R + r\cos(v))\cos(u), \quad y = (R + r\cos(v))\sin(u), \quad z = r\sin(v)
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a torus with major radius R and minor radius r

formulas.name: Klein Bottle Figure-8 Immersion
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a Klein bottle immersion in 3D space using the figure-8 formulation

implementations.python:
def klein_bottle(u: float, v: float, r: float = 1.0) -> tuple:
    import math
    half_u = u / 2
    cos_u, sin_u = math.cos(u), math.sin(u)
    cos_v, sin_v = math.cos(v), math.sin(v)
    
    x = r * (cos_u * (1 + sin_u) + sin_v * (1 - cos_u / 2))
    y = r * sin_u + cos_v * (1 - cos_u / 2)
    z = r * math.sin(half_u) * sin_v
    
    return (x, y, z)

formulas.name: Möbius Strip Parametric Equations
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a Möbius strip with half-twist

implementations.python:
def mobius_strip(u: float, v: float, R: float = 1.0) -> tuple:
    import math
    theta = u * 2 * math.pi
    s = v - 0.5
    half_theta = theta / 2
    
    x = (R + s * math.cos(half_theta)) * math.cos(theta)
    y = (R + s * math.cos(half_theta)) * math.sin(theta)
    z = s * math.sin(half_theta)
    
    return (x, y, z)

formulas.name: Catenoid Parametric Equations
formulas.latex: x = c\cosh(\frac{v}{c})\cos(u), \quad y = c\cosh(\frac{v}{c})\sin(u), \quad z = v
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a catenoid, the minimal surface of revolution

formulas.name: Helicoid Parametric Equations
formulas.latex: x = v\cos(u), \quad y = v\sin(u), \quad z = cu
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a helicoid, a ruled minimal surface

formulas.name: Enneper Surface Parametric Equations
formulas.latex: x = u - \frac{u^3}{3} + uv^2, \quad y = v - \frac{v^3}{3} + vu^2, \quad z = u^2 - v^2
formulas.description: Polynomial parametric equations for the Enneper minimal surface

formulas.name: Tesseract 4D to 3D Projection
formulas.latex: P_{3D} = \frac{w}{w + d} \cdot (x, y, z) \text{ where } d \text{ is viewing distance}
formulas.description: Perspective projection of a 4D tesseract (hypercube) into 3D space
